content.text: {"utterance": "I'll start with a concern and a proposal. Permission exists to archive the twelve interviews, not to excerpt them publicly or give them an AI voice. So the kiosk can't speak in a contributor's first person yet. Before we build anything, I'd ask: who corrects it when it misstates someone, and who answers if a contributor objects? I could support a searchable exhibit where every excerpt is contributor-approved, attributed, and linked to its full context. Theo, could we label an estimate for the consent-gathering work before we spend credits on interface design?", "cites": ["M1", "M2"], "memory": "Skeptical of first-person AI voice. Supports searchable, contributor-approved, attributed exhibit. Wants consent for excerpts first, a named owner for corrections, and a labeled estimate for consent work from Theo."}
